issues.legal_issue: Tax assessment proceedings concerning property whose taxability depends on the outcome of unresolved title litigation should be finalized after that litigation is disposed of.
material_facts: The estate remained under Court of Wards management after its last holder died because succession was disputed.
A claimant brought a suit asserting heirship, while the State claimed the estate had vested in it by escheat.
The tax authorities assessed the estate’s income through its manager while the title dispute remained unresolved.
Although the claimant’s suit had been dismissed, an appeal was pending, and it was not yet possible to determine whether the estate had escheated.

The High Court held that tax could not be imposed merely because the title suit was pending; the Supreme Court set aside that judgment and directed that the proceedings be finalized after the litigation ended.
issues.conclusion: The assessment proceedings should be finalized after the title litigation is disposed of. The High Court may call for a supplementary statement of the case if necessary; whether the estate escheated was left open.
issues.legal_principle: Where taxability depends on whether property has escheated to the State, and that status remains unresolved in pending title litigation, the proceedings should be finalized after the litigation is disposed of rather than resolved on the assumption that the estate has or has not escheated. The Court noted that there could be no income-tax assessment in the event of escheat. Section 13 of the Bengal Court of Wards Act, 1879, provided for the Court of Wards to retain charge of disputed property until the claimant’s right was determined. Articles 289 and 296 of the Constitution were referred to by the High Court. The assessment at the maximum rate under section 41(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1922, was not decided. No earlier cases were cited.

rule.if: tax_assessment_appeal and title_litigation_pending and taxability_depends_on_title_status and title_status_unresolved

predicates.tax_assessment_appeal: A court is considering an appeal or reference arising from tax assessment proceedings.
predicates.title_litigation_pending: A claimant and another claimant or the State are litigating who is entitled to the relevant property.
predicates.taxability_depends_on_title_status: Whether income from the property is taxable depends on which claimant is ultimately entitled to it.
predicates.title_status_unresolved: The pending litigation has not finally determined whether the property belongs to the claimant or has vested in the State.

issues.definition: When a court is reviewing a tax assessment and pending title litigation leaves unresolved a property status on which taxability depends, the assessment proceedings are finalized after the title litigation ends.
